'''Garm Trodask''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and commander of the bounty hunting team known as [[Grim Destiny]]. He led the team when they pursued the Hutt, [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]], on the planet [[Trendivar]].
